Date: 06-07-2026
READVERTISEMENT NOTICE
Interested and eligible candidates are invited to attend a walk-in-interview to be held on 17th
July 2026 at 11:00 AM in the Department of Botany, University of Kashmir, Srinagar, for
one (01) position of Senior Research Fellow (SRF). The position is sanctioned under the
research project entitled “Scientific and Technological Interventions for Socio-Economic
Empowerment of Women Folk of Dab Village of District Ganderbal, Kashmir, UT of
J&K”, funded by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India.
The appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project and will be governed
by the terms, conditions and eligibility criteria prescribed for the project.

Eligible candidates must bring: A duly signed application for the position Biodata /CV Self-
attested photocopies of certificates, testimonials and other relevant documents.
Candidates must also produce the original certificates at the time of interview in support of
their qualifications, percentage of marks and any relevant research experience. After
selection, the candidate will be appointed with retrospective effect from the date of
resignation of the previous incumbent.
No TA/DA shall be provided for appearing in the interview.
